points.description: Resolution (LSB) of the ADC: writes the formula LSB = VFS/2^N (accept VFS/(2^N − 1)) and substitutes VFS = 5 V, N = 12 to get LSB ≈ 1.22 mV (5/4096 = 1.2207 mV; 1.2210 mV with 4095 also accepted). The formula must be written; a bare 1.22 mV with no formula earns 0 for this point. If a wrong range is used (10 V or ±5 V), flag it; award marks only if arithmetic matches the stated range and formula.

levels.says: Formula VFS/2^N written and substituted correctly but the arithmetic result is wrong or missing.

points.description: Divides the LSB voltage by the sensitivity: dF = 1.22 mV / (10 mV/N) = 0.122 N (0.1221 N). Multiplying by the sensitivity instead earns 0 here. If no LSB formula was shown, this mark is given only if the division itself is shown.

rubric.notes: Full marks: LSB computed from a written VFS/2^N (1.22 mV) and divided by 10 mV/N to give 0.122 N. Using 4095 instead of 4096 is accepted in full. Multiplying by sensitivity loses the last mark; a bare 1.22 mV with no formula earns no LSB marks.
rubric.answer_key: LSB = VFS/2^N = 5 V/4096 = 1.2207 mV. Smallest resolvable force change = LSB / sensitivity = 1.2207 mV / (10 mV/N) = 0.1221 N (≈0.122 N).
